note: The colour version of the BFS-U3-16S2M-CS: a cased USB3 Vision camera with a CS-mount and an IR-cut filter (670 nm). Sold without a lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Sony IMX273, 1440 x 1080, 1/2.9", pixel size "3.45" (no unit given; micrometres), maximum frame rate 226 fps; ADC 10 and 12 bit; pixel formats not listed (format null). Exposure "4 us to 30 seconds". power_w is the stated maximum, 3 W. size_mm is the stated 29 x 29 x 30 mm (W x H x L), entered as [30, 29, 29].
